tools.name: check_solana_token
tools.description: Scam/rug risk check for a Solana SPL or Token-2022 token mint. Returns a 0-100 risk score (HIGHER = RISKIER), a verdict, and flags with plain-English reasons: mint/freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer hooks/fees, holder concentration, liquidity, LP burn/lock %, Streamflow locks and a simul

tools.name: deep_check_solana_token
tools.description: Deep Solana token risk check (PAID, x402 over REST): holder concentration (top1/top5/top10 % of supply), top wallets linked by a shared funder (bundles/insiders), creator-funded holders, fresh wallets, LP lock/burn status, authorities, score + reasons. This tool returns exact x402 payment instructio

tools.name: batch_check_solana_tokens
tools.description: Batch Solana token risk check (PAID, x402 over REST): up to 20 mints in one call for one flat price. This tool returns exact x402 payment instructions for POST /v1/paid/batch-check.

tools.name: diff_solana_token
tools.description: Watch/diff a Solana token: pass the mint and a previous Haris result (from check_solana_token or an earlier diff); returns alerts on what changed (authority re-enabled, LP unlocked, liquidity pulled, sell blocked, new red flags) plus the fresh result. Shares the free tier with check_solana_token; th

tools.name: get_haris_burn_game
tools.description: Free $HARIS Burn Game (Round 1) stats: total burned, remaining 100,000,000 capacity, round status, returnsStatus (instant 1:1 returns when live), and the top-20 leaderboard (wallet, total burned, number of burns). Read-only. Never signs. The same amount is returned instantly and automatically from t

tools.name: plan_haris_burn
tools.description: Build an unsigned $HARIS Burn Game transaction for a given Solana wallet and amount (max 10,000 HARIS, memo haris-burn-round-1). Returns a base64 unsigned tx for the wallet owner to sign. Haris never signs or holds keys. Not a payout.

tools.name: claim_haris_burn
tools.description: Submit a confirmed $HARIS Burn Game transaction signature. Verifies the on-chain burn, credits the 1:1 return, and sends the same amount back immediately from the Round 1 wallet when instant returns are on. Idempotent per signature. Haris never signs.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "claim_haris_burn" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens · Private data: check_solana_token, deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token, get_haris_burn_game, plan_haris_burn, claim_haris_burn · Public sink: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token, claim_haris_burn.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens · Private data: check_solana_token, deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token, get_haris_burn_game, plan_haris_burn, claim_haris_burn · Public sink: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token, claim_haris_burn

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
